name: Swipe the whole bar to scrub desks
author: wizard
description: On the phone, drag sideways anywhere on the bottom bar, the orb included, to step through desks one by one from the first move, with a tick and the desk name above the bar; let go to land there. Drag left goes to the desks on the right. A quick flick still moves one desk. The little handle under the orb goes away.
